title: FLA import: motionTweenRotate and rotateTimes silently skipped
description: flash8-binary.ts lines 1800-1801 use r.skip(4) twice for motionTweenRotate (u32: 1=none,2=auto,3=CW,4=CCW) and rotateTimes (u32: extra full rotations). Model fields motionRotate and motionRotateCount exist and the tween interpolator uses them, but they never populate from FLA import. Spinning logo animations import with zero rotation. Fix: decode both u32 values and pass into createFrame.
